999008199.text: はぁ、はぁっ……

……ここまで！
お前たちの武、堪能させてもらった

localizations.en: ...That's enough! I've thoroughly enjoyed witnessing your martial prowess.

999008199.text: あ、ありがとうございます……

（千歳さんが疲れたからやめた……？
　まだ全力じゃない……？）

localizations.en: (She stopped because Chitose got tired...? She wasn't even going full strength...?)

999008199.text:
錬金術を見て何やら井の中の蛙の気分であったが
なに、余の武は大海でも通用しそうであるな！

localizations.en: After seeing your alchemy, I was feeling like a frog in a well, but it seems my martial skills would hold up even in the vast ocean!

999008199.text:
若くしてこれほどの武をお持ちとは……
お世辞ではなく、神聖国にも並ぶ者はいません

localizations.en: To possess such martial prowess at such a young age... I'm not flattering you when I say there's no one in the sacred lands who could match you.

999008199.text:
天に黄金星の光あれば
地に鏑矢の輝きあり……

localizations.en: When the golden star shines in the heavens, Kaburaya's brilliance illuminates the earth...

999008199.text:
鏑矢様が幼少のみぎり
悪名高い魔物を討伐した際の評判、です

localizations.en: That was the praise given when Lady Kaburaya slayed a notorious monster in her youth.

999008199.text:
うむ、余に並ぶものがあるとすれば
それこそ天の黄金星くらいのものよ、はっはっは！

localizations.en: Indeed! If anything could match me, it would have to be the golden star in the heavens itself! Ha ha ha!

999008199.text:
（事前に聞いてはいたけど、ここまで強いなんて……
　敵に回したら一巻の終わりだあ……）

localizations.en: (I heard about this beforehand, but to think she's actually this strong... If we made an enemy of her, it'd be all over...)

999008199.text:
（あの人に気に入られつつコウセンを倒す……
　そのとっかかりはやっぱり錬金術、だよね）

localizations.en: (Getting her to like us while taking down Kosen... The key to that is definitely alchemy.)

999008199.text:
あの……１つお願いがあります！
ケイウンで錬金術の素材探しをしてもいいでしょうか！

localizations.en: Um... I have one request! Would it be all right if we searched for alchemy materials here in Keiun?

999008199.text: 別に構わんが、余に何か益をくれ

localizations.en: I don't mind, but what is in it for me?

999008199.text:
ケイウンの素材を使った錬金術の品物を
鏑矢様にお見せいたします

localizations.en: I'll synthesize alchemical items made using Keiun's materials.

999008199.text: ふむ、なるほど……
１割、できたものを納めるならばいい

localizations.en: You may do so if you hand over ten percent of what you create.

999008199.text:
…………！
ありがとうございます！

この城にもケイウン特産物の蓄えはある。
後ほど届けさせよう。素材に使ってくれ

localizations.en: This castle has a stockpile of Keiun specialties as well. I'll have them delivered to you later. Feel free to do with them as you wish.

999008199.text: 何から何まで……ありがとうございます

localizations.en: You're too kind... Thank you so much.

999008199.text:
ケイウンの素材で何が編み出されるのか
今から楽しみにしておこう

localizations.en: I'm looking forward to seeing what you'll create with Keiun's materials.

999008199.text: は、はい……
重圧、すごいね……

錬金術の素晴らしさを目にしたからな。
余が期待するのも当然だろう

localizations.en: I've witnessed the magnificence of alchemy. It's only natural that I'd have high expectations.

999008199.text:
そうだ、お返しにといってはなんだが
次に来た時は、我が国が誇る陰陽術をご覧に入れよう

localizations.en: Ah yes, as a return gesture, the next time you visit, I'll show you the onmyoji arts that our nation takes pride in.

999008199.text:
コウセンというケイウン一の陰陽師がいてな。
あいつの陰陽術は余のお墨付きよ……

localizations.en: There's an onmyoji named Kosen, the finest in all of Keiun. His onmyoji techniques have my personal seal of approval...

999008199.text:
そうですか……ぜひ、またの機会に。
お目にかかりたいです

localizations.en: Is that so... I'd definitely like to meet him sometime.

999008199.text: では、今日のところは……

ああ、そうだ！　つかぬことを聞くが
そちらの国に永遠と鬼門を名乗る男女はいなかったか？

localizations.en: Ah, that reminds me! If I may ask—have you met a man and a woman going by Towa and Kimon?

999008199.text: いえ、聞いたことはありません

localizations.en: No, I've never heard of those names.

999008199.text:
だろうな。お尋ね者だし偽名を使っているだろう。
後で人相書きを渡すので、もし見つけたら捕まえてくれ

localizations.en: I thought not. They're wanted criminals, so they're probably using false names. I'll give you wanted posters later. If you spot them, please capture them.

999008199.text:
それ相応の褒美を取らせるからな。
呼び止めてすまなかった

localizations.en: And I'll see that you're properly rewarded. I won't detain you any longer.

999008199.text: いえ……それでは、失礼します

localizations.en: Not at all... Well then, we'll take our leave.
